status: DRAFT -- rendered and linted by C-9; NOT declared COMPLETE as a pack (the conductor declares after Matt's look and moves it to join1_pack/)

source.h_model_method: rest pose, the body mesh skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres (every 7th vertex; sole 0.0001, crown 2.4706)

camera.frame: port model: x screen-right, y toward camera, z up; origin = character ground origin
camera.character_heading: theta = 90 - bearing about +Y (the model faces +Z); frame-0 root forward measured per cell

image.lights_detail: the Barrow's winter sun (paint_stack.gd: 55 deg, screen azimuth 305, (1.0, 0.955, 0.885), energy 0.90, shadow blur 1.7) as a child of the camera, ambient 0.30 white; self-shadowing only (no ground)

idle.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

walk.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (1.600 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (1.0000 s)
walk.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

run.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (3.210 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (0.6000 s)
run.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

attack_swipe.skill: the roster's double swipe (melee 0-2.95 m); release = the left rake's contact

attack_kick.skill: the roster's leg claw (melee 0-3.02 m); release = the sickle claw's stab

attack_leap.skill: the roster's leap (aoe r 2.8 m at landing); release = the landing; the travel is the runtime's

sockets_def.claw_L_tip: the LEFT forelimb's claw tip (wrist -> tip, measured)
sockets_def.sickle_R: the RIGHT foot's ball, where the sickle claw sits
sockets_def.head_top: the crest at the back of the skull

alpha_union_bbox_convention: [x0, y0, x1, y1), x1/y1 exclusive -- PIL getchannel('A').getbbox(), as stage_art.py crops
